description: Na₅LiMn₂P₂(CO₇)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. There are five inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.70 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.75 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.87 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.57 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.83 Å. Li is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.63 Å. There are two inequivalent Mn sites. In the first Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.14-2.38 Å. In the second Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.11-2.35 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.30 Å) and one longer (1.31 Å) C-O bond length. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. All C-O bond lengths are 1.30 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-59°. All P-O bond lengths are 1.56 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-60°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.55-1.57 Å. There are fourteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Li, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Li, one Mn, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mn, and one C atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mn, and one C atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₃MnC trigonal bipyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Li, one Mn, and one C atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂LiMnC trigonal bipyramids. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mn, and one P atom to form distorted ONa₂MnP trigonal pyramids that share corners with three ONa₂MnP tetrahedra and corners with three ONa₃MnC trigonal bipyramids. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mn, and one P atom to form distorted ONa₂MnP tetrahedra that share corners with three ONa₃MnC trigonal bipyramids and corners with two equivalent ONa₂MnP trigonal pyramids. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one P atom to form distorted ONaLiMnP tetrahedra that share corners with three ONa₃MnC trigonal bipyramids and  a cornercorner with one ONa₂MnP trigonal pyramid. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one P atom.
